neighbours.label: the word ' cheap' (after relatively / reasonably)
fire: The hotel was clean and relatively cheap for the city.
Solar panels have become surprisingly cheap in recent years.
They found a reasonably cheap flight to Lisbon in May.
Farmers can now produce cheap food for the growing towns.
The team signed a veteran fairly cheap on a one-year deal.
Plastic toys are cheap but break after a few weeks.
The market sells cheap fruit late in the afternoon.
Running the old heater is cheap but very noisy.
quiet: The hotel was clean and relatively quiet for the city.
Solar panels have become surprisingly common in recent years.
They found a reasonably short flight to Lisbon in May.
Farmers can now produce fresh food for the growing towns.
The team signed a veteran fairly quickly on a one-year deal.
Plastic toys are bright but break after a few weeks.
The market sells ripe fruit late in the afternoon.
Running the old heater is easy but very noisy.
